title: MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot
description: The nudge payout is full-balance, winner-take-all, with permissionless entry and a caller-chosen recipient (payout at lines 251-253). The first qualifying caller in a block takes the whole pot. A searcher can observe an honest qualifying batchMint in the mempool, copy it with recipient = searcher and a higher priority fee, land first, and scoop the entire pot. This is a distinct root cause from H-01 (mechanism design / mempool race, not pot-funding misconfig) with a distinct mitigation surface.
impact: The nudge pot is paid to a front-running searcher instead of the honest qualifying minter. The honest user still pays mint cost + gas and receives no nudge (sees nudgeAmount == 0). Value is leaked away from the intended recipient; the fairness/function of the nudge incentive is degraded.
attackPath: 1. Honest user broadcasts a qualifying batchMint (count >= nudgeSize) with recipient = self.
2. A searcher observes the mempool, copies the call with recipient = searcher and a higher priority fee.
3. Searcher's tx lands first; the winner-take-all full-balance payout transfers the whole pot to the searcher.
4. The honest user's tx executes against an empty pot (nudgeAmount == 0): they pay mint cost + gas, mint the NFTs, and receive no nudge.
recommendation: Remove the winner-take-all mempool race. Options: (1) bind the nudge recipient to msg.sender (no caller-chosen recipient); (2) use per-spend accounting so the nudge accrues to the actual spender rather than the first to clear a shared full-balance gate; (3) commit-reveal or batched settlement to remove the front-runnable single-block race. A coded PoC is required before report generation demonstrating the front-run capturing the pot ahead of an honest qualifying call.
